input_sheets.description: Main dataset containing vendor invoices with payment details, amounts, dates, and approval status. This is the working dataset that gets filtered and enriched through the processing pipeline.

columns.description: Legal name of the vendor/supplier providing goods or services. Used for matching against hold lists and name correction mappings.
identifying_patterns: May contain LLC, Inc, Co suffixes
Matched against Payment Hold List and Vendor Name Changes sheets

columns.description: Unique identifier for each invoice. Primary key used to deduplicate against previously uploaded and unpaid invoice lists.
Date when the invoice was issued by the vendor. Normalized to current month/year if in past periods.
identifying_patterns: Dates in past months updated to processing date

columns.description: Payment deadline for the invoice. Used to determine payment urgency and workflow priority.
identifying_patterns: May be before or after invoice date

columns.description: Invoice amount in currency (USD). Critical for financial reporting and payment totals. Formatted to remove .00 from whole numbers.
identifying_patterns: Summed for final payment total reporting

columns.description: Business classification or expense category for the invoice (e.g., Office Supplies, Consulting, Marketing, Services, Technology).
identifying_patterns: Used for expense classification and reporting

columns.description: Narrative description of goods or services provided. Typically follows pattern 'Payment for [category] services'.
identifying_patterns: May be redundant with Category field

columns.description: Current workflow state of the payment (Pending, Processing, Approved). Indicates position in approval pipeline.
Date when the payment was approved. Normalized to current month/year if in past periods.
identifying_patterns: Dates in past months updated to processing date
May be null for non-approved payments

columns.description: Mechanism for payment delivery (Wire Transfer, ACH, Check). Determines payment processing method.
identifying_patterns: Enumerated values: Wire Transfer, ACH, Check

identifying_traits: Sheet name starts with 'report' followed by numeric identifier
Contains 150+ rows of invoice records
Includes vendor names, invoice identifiers, and monetary amounts
Has workflow status field (Pending, Processing, Approved)
Contains multiple date fields for invoice lifecycle tracking

input_sheets.description: Blocklist of vendor names whose payments should be excluded from processing. Acts as a filter to prevent payments to specified vendors.

columns.description: Name of vendor placed on payment hold. Matched case-insensitively against vendor names in primary sheet to exclude their invoices.

identifying_traits: Sheet named 'Payment Hold List'
Single column containing vendor names
Small dataset (2-10 rows typically)
Vendor names match against primary sheet for filtering

input_sheets.description: Lookup table for correcting and standardizing vendor names. Maps original/legacy vendor names to their current correct names.

columns.description: Legacy or incorrect vendor name that may appear in invoice records.
identifying_patterns: Vendor names with variations (LLC, Co, Inc suffixes)
Matched exactly against primary sheet vendor names

columns.description: Standardized, current legal name for the vendor. Replaces original name in processed records.

identifying_traits: Sheet named 'Vendor Name Changes'
Two columns: original and corrected names
Small reference dataset (3-20 rows)
Used to normalize vendor names before processing

input_sheets.description: Historical record of all invoices that have been uploaded/processed in previous runs. Used to identify and exclude paid invoices from current processing.

columns.description: Unique invoice identifier from previously processed batches. Matched against current invoices to identify duplicates.
identifying_patterns: Matches invoice numbers in primary sheet

columns.description: Date when the invoice was previously uploaded/processed. Provides audit trail of processing history.
identifying_patterns: Indicates when invoice was last processed

identifying_traits: Sheet named 'Previously Uploaded Sheet'
Two columns: invoice number and upload date
Larger dataset (30+ rows) tracking historical uploads
Invoice numbers matched against primary sheet for deduplication

input_sheets.description: Registry of invoices from previously uploaded batches that remain unpaid. Used to identify which historical invoices should still be included in current processing.

columns.description: Unique invoice identifier for unpaid invoices. Invoices in this list are NOT removed from processing (they remain unpaid).
Number of days since invoice was issued and remains unpaid. Indicates payment aging and urgency.

identifying_traits: Sheet named 'Unpaid Uploads'
Two columns: invoice number and days outstanding
Smaller dataset (10-20 rows) of outstanding invoices
Invoices in this list are excluded from the 'paid' set

transformation_rules.name: Load Source Data
transformation_rules.description: Load all vendor payment records from the primary source sheet (sheet name starting with 'report')
transformation_rules.logic: Read Excel sheet matching pattern 'report*' and preserve all columns and values without modification

transformation_rules.name: Filter Payment Holds
transformation_rules.description: Remove invoices from vendors listed on the Payment Hold List to prevent payments to blocked vendors
transformation_rules.logic: Case-insensitive match of Vendor Name against Payment Hold List; exclude matching records from main processing and segregate to Payment Holds sheet

transformation_rules.name: Normalize Past Dates
transformation_rules.description: Update invoice dates, due dates, and approval dates that are in past months/years to the current processing date
transformation_rules.logic: For each date field (Invoice Date, Due Date, Approval Date): if date.year < current_year OR (date.year == current_year AND date.month < current_month), replace with processing_date; convert to M/D/YY format

transformation_rules.name: Standardize Vendor Names
transformation_rules.description: Replace original/legacy vendor names with corrected standardized names using the Vendor Name Changes mapping table
transformation_rules.logic: Exact match lookup: if Vendor Name exists in Original Vendor Name column, replace with corresponding Corrected Vendor Name value

transformation_rules.name: Remove Previously Paid Invoices
transformation_rules.description: Exclude invoices that have been previously uploaded and marked as paid (in Previously Uploaded but not in Unpaid Uploads)
transformation_rules.logic: Calculate paid_invoices = Previously_Uploaded - Unpaid_Uploads; exclude any Invoice Number in paid_invoices from main processing; segregate removed records to Previously Uploaded sheet

transformation_rules.name: Generate Bill Payment IDs
transformation_rules.description: Assign sequential unique identifiers to each processed payment record for Bill.com integration
transformation_rules.logic: Generate sequential integers starting from 1 for each row in the filtered dataset; assign to Bill Payment ID column

transformation_rules.name: Assign GL Account
transformation_rules.description: Assign constant general ledger account code to all payment records for accounting classification
transformation_rules.logic: Set GL Account = '60000' for all records in the final payment dataset

transformation_rules.name: Format Amount Values
transformation_rules.description: Remove .00 decimal suffix from whole number amounts for cleaner output formatting
transformation_rules.logic: For each Amount value: if value == int(value), convert to integer; otherwise preserve as float with decimal places

transformation_rules.name: Format Date Output
transformation_rules.description: Normalize date formatting to remove leading zeros from month and day components
transformation_rules.logic: For each date field: parse M/D/YY format and reconstruct as int(month)/int(day)/YY to remove leading zeros (e.g., '02/04/26' becomes '2/4/26')

semantic_validations.name: Invoice Number Uniqueness
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all Invoice Numbers in the final Vendor Payments output are unique and no duplicates exist
semantic_validations.check_logic: Count distinct Invoice Numbers should equal total row count in Vendor Payments sheet; no Invoice Number should appear more than once

semantic_validations.name: Payment Hold Exclusion
semantic_validations.description: Verify that no vendor names from the Payment Hold List appear in the final Vendor Payments output
semantic_validations.check_logic: Intersect(Vendor Payments.Vendor Name, Payment Hold List.Vendor Name) should be empty set; case-insensitive comparison

semantic_validations.name: Previously Paid Exclusion
semantic_validations.description: Verify that no paid invoices (Previously Uploaded minus Unpaid Uploads) appear in the final Vendor Payments output
semantic_validations.check_logic: Intersect(Vendor Payments.Invoice Number, paid_invoices) should be empty set where paid_invoices = Previously_Uploaded - Unpaid_Uploads

semantic_validations.name: Bill Payment ID Sequentiality
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Bill Payment IDs form a continuous sequence starting from 1 with no gaps
semantic_validations.check_logic: Bill Payment ID values should be [1, 2, 3, ..., n] where n = row count; no missing or duplicate IDs

semantic_validations.name: GL Account Consistency
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all records in Vendor Payments have GL Account set to the constant value '60000'
semantic_validations.check_logic: All GL Account values in Vendor Payments should equal '60000'; no null or alternative values

semantic_validations.name: Vendor Name Standardization Completeness
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all vendor names in Vendor Payments match the Corrected Vendor Name values from the mapping table where applicable
semantic_validations.check_logic: For each Original Vendor Name in Vendor Name Changes, verify no instances remain in Vendor Payments output; all should be replaced with Corrected Vendor Name

semantic_validations.name: Date Format Consistency
semantic_validations.description: Verify that all date fields (Invoice Date, Due Date, Approval Date) follow the M/D/YY format without leading zeros
semantic_validations.check_logic: All date values should match regex pattern ^\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}/\d{2}$ (no leading zeros on month/day); null values are acceptable

semantic_validations.name: Amount Data Type Integrity
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Amount values are properly formatted as integers (no .00) or floats with decimal places
semantic_validations.check_logic: Whole number amounts should not contain decimal point; fractional amounts should preserve decimal places; all values should be numeric

semantic_validations.name: Raw Data Completeness
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Raw Data sheet contains all original records from the source sheet without any filtering
semantic_validations.check_logic: Row count in Raw Data should equal original source sheet row count; all columns and values should be preserved exactly

semantic_validations.name: Audit Trail Reconciliation
semantic_validations.description: Verify that the sum of records across all output sheets equals the original input count
semantic_validations.check_logic: Vendor Payments + Payment Holds + Previously Uploaded = Raw Data row count; no records should be lost or duplicated across sheets

semantic_validations.name: Status Field Validity
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Status field values are limited to enumerated values: Pending, Processing, or Approved
semantic_validations.check_logic: All Status values in Vendor Payments should be one of: 'Pending', 'Processing', 'Approved'; no other values allowed

semantic_validations.name: Payment Method Validity
semantic_validations.description: Verify that Payment Method field values are limited to enumerated values: Wire Transfer, ACH, or Check
semantic_validations.check_logic: All Payment Method values in Vendor Payments should be one of: 'Wire Transfer', 'ACH', 'Check'; no other values allowed
